acceptanceCriteria: obligations reports NO-TEST-BOUNDARY for an open/blocked obligation whose cited locations all sit in repositories with no runnable test provider, or that cites no tracked code; it lists the repositories checked and each one's test inventory.

A scope-change command sets the in-scope/core flag only with a recorded decision (who, when, why, evidence ref) kept in obligation history and shown in status; it refuses without one. Completion rates count in-scope obligations only and list out-of-scope ones separately with their decision.
When a test provider later appears for such a repository, the out-of-scope obligations are listed as re-scope candidates.
Fixture tests for all three acceptance cases from the issue; requirements in the owning obligations spec; Closes #1180.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1180. Obligations implemented entirely outside any repository with a runnable test provider (warehouse SQL, BI model filters) stay core and blocked forever, depress completion rates and get re-triaged repeatedly.
title: GH #1180: obligations NO-TEST-BOUNDARY detector and owner-gated in-scope/core decisions
